content.text:
I can't reproduce Sega's Sonic character art, but here's an **original** speedy blue hedgehog in a similar spirit that you're free to use anywhere:

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 220" width="240" height="220">
  <!-- speed lines -->
  <g stroke="#7fd3ff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="10" y1="90" x2="55" y2="90"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="115" x2="60" y2="115"/>
    <line x1="5"  y1="140" x2="50" y2="140"/>
  </g>

  <!-- back quills -->
  <path d="M95 70 L40 55 L80 90 L30 100 L82 112 L45 140 L100 128 Z"
        fill="#1f5fd1" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="125" cy="95" r="45" fill="#2a74f0" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- top quill -->
  <path d="M110 55 Q120 25 150 30 Q135 45 140 58 Z"
        fill="#2a74f0" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <path d="M138 58 L150 38 L158 62 Z" fill="#2a74f0" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M143 57 L150 45 L154 60 Z" fill="#ffc9a8"/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="150" cy="112" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#ffd9bd" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <ellipse cx="143" cy="88" rx="14" ry="17" fill="#fff" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="148" cy="90" r="7" fill="#1aa86b"/>
  <circle cx="150" cy="89" r="3.5" fill="#000"/>
  <circle cx="152" cy="86" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- nose + grin -->
  <circle cx="172" cy="104" r="5" fill="#111"/>
  <path d="M148 120 Q160 128 170 118" fill="none" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="118" cy="150" rx="24" ry="22" fill="#2a74f0" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="124" cy="152" rx="13" ry="14" fill="#ffd9bd"/>

  <!-- arm -->
  <path d="M135 140 Q160 135 172 150" fill="none" stroke="#ffd9bd" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="174" cy="152" r="9" fill="#fff" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <path d="M110 168 L95 190" stroke="#2a74f0" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M126 168 L145 186" stroke="#2a74f0" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- sneakers -->
  <path d="M75 190 Q90 180 105 192 Q100 202 75 200 Z" fill="#ffb400" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="78" y="196" width="26" height="4" fill="#fff"/>
  <path d="M138 182 Q158 172 172 186 Q166 198 140 194 Z" fill="#ffb400" stroke="#0d2f73" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <rect x="142" y="190" width="26" height="4" fill="#fff"/>
</svg>
```

Save it as `hedgehog.svg` and open it in a browser. I can also change the colors, give it a different pose, add a CSS running animation, or save it into the `mesa` repo if you tell me where it should go.
